llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究钨铜功能梯度材料的选区激光熔化，与生物医学植入物的应力遮挡或表面粗糙度无关。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure for stiffness matching, no fatigue testing, no osseointegration or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 制备具有梯度成分的钨铜合金以适应热管理需求。
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化逐层熔覆不同配比的钨铜粉末。
summary_zh.result: 成功制备无裂纹、成分梯度连续变化的钨铜样品。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM和EDS表征微观结构与成分分布。

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate tungsten-copper functionally graded materials with tailored thermal properties for high-heat-flux applications.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting is used to build layers with varying W/Cu ratios by sequential powder deposition and melting.
summary_en.result: Dense, crack-free graded samples with continuous composition change from pure W to pure Cu are obtained.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural and compositional characterization using SEM and EDS confirms the gradient and densification.

papers.title: Optimization of SLM process parameters for Ti6Al4V medical implants
papers.abstract: Purpose Ti6Al4V alloy has received a great deal of attention in medical applications due to its biomechanical compatibility. However, the human bone stiffness is between 10 and 30 GPa while solid Ti6Al4V is several times stiffer, which would cause stress shielding with the surrounding bone, which can lead to implant and/or the surrounding bone’s failure. Design/methodology/approach In this work, the effect of selective laser melting (SLM) process parameters on the characteristics of Ti6Al4V samples, such as porosity level, surface roughness, elastic modulus and compressive strength (UCS), has been investigated using response surface method. The examined ranges of process parameters were 35-50 W for laser power, 100-400 mm/s for scan speed and 35-120 µm for hatch spacing. The process parameters have been optimized to obtain structures with properties very close to that in human bones. Findings The results showed that the porosity percentage of a SLM component could be increased by reducing the laser power and/or increasing the scan speed and hatch spacing. It was also shown that there was a reverse relationship between the porosity level and both the modulus of elasticity and UCS of the SLM part. In addition, the increased laser power was resulted into a substantial decrease of the surface roughness of SLM parts. Results from the optimization study revealed that the interaction between laser process parameters (i.e. laser power, laser speed, and the laser spacing) have the most significant influence on the mechanical properties of fabricated samples. The optimized values for the manufacturing of medical implants were 49 W, 400 mm/s and 99 µm for the laser power, laser speed and laser spacing, respectively. The corresponding porosity, surface roughness, modulus of elasticity and UCS were 23.62 per cent, 8.68 µm, 30 GPa and 522 MPa, respectively. Originality/value Previous investigations related to additive manufacturing of Ti alloys have focused on producing fully dense and high-integrity structures. There is a clear gap in literature regarding the simultaneous enhancement and adjustment of pore fraction, surface and mechanical properties of Ti6Al4V SLM components toward biomedical implants. This was the objective of the current study.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM参数对Ti6Al4V多孔结构力学性能的影响，为髋关节植入物应力遮挡问题提供了材料层面的优化思路。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include any implant geometry, FE modeling, or specific hip implant biomechanical evaluation such as stress/strain distribution or micromotion analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化SLM参数以降低Ti6Al4V植入物的弹性模量，减少应力遮挡。
summary_zh.method: 采用响应面法分析激光功率、扫描速度和间距对孔隙率、粗糙度、模量和强度的影响。
summary_zh.result: 优化参数得到30 GPa模量和23.6%孔隙率，接近骨骼性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩测试和表面粗糙度测量验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize selective laser melting parameters to produce Ti6Al4V implants with stiffness matching human bone and reducing stress shielding.
summary_en.method: Response surface methodology was used to model the effects of laser power, scan speed, and hatch spacing on porosity, surface roughness, elastic modulus, and compressive strength.
summary_en.result: Optimal parameters (49 W, 400 mm/s, 99 µm) yielded a modulus of 30 GPa, porosity of 23.62%, and compressive strength of 522 MPa.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical compression testing and surface roughness measurements.
